name: Modern Biology: Principles and Applications
description: Complexity in biological systems; Gene and molecular network; Genome organization; Gene editing; Sequencing technologies; Computational approaches in Biology; Environmental microbiology; Emerging trends in Cancer biology; Metabolic disorders; Neurodegenerative disorders; Introductory Stem cell biology: Stem cell development and differentiation, applications; Emerging diagnostic technologies (challenges in traditional diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, point-of-care diagnostics); Drug design and delivery (computational and screening-based drug design, antiboby-drug conjugates, encapsulation, peptide-based drugs and delivery systems); Engineering designs inspired by biology (molecular motors, DNA origami, molecular mimicry); Sustainability in Bioengineering and Bioethics.
